description: List the most recent Federal Register documents, optionally filtered by type and issuing agency, over a look-back window. Use this to monitor newly published rules/notices from an agency.

days.description: Look back this many days (default 7, max 90).

type.description: Document type. One of: rule, proposed_rule, notice, presidential_document.

name: recent_documents

provenance.description: Where this answer came from. served_at is when Datakoot answered (UTC); upstream lists the official sources consulted. Datakoot may serve a briefly cached copy, so the source's own observation can be older than served_at.

title: Recent Documents
